condensate collection system centrally collects the condensate generated during compression. An integrated float switch reliably monitors the fill level. The silencer and filter unit reduce noise and prevent unpleasant odors in the working environment. Base frame On the extended base frame, the compressor and up to two storage cylinders, each with a geometric volume of 50 or 80 liters, are mounted to form a turnkey system. This compact solution simplifies both installation and operation. Subframe for ship loading The additional auxiliary frame allows qualified personnel to load the compressor system onto a ship using a crane and designated lifting devices. The system can be operated permanently with the integrated frame. Exhaust shaft For installation in containers or operating rooms, two exhaust duct variants are available: without ventilation flaps for vertical discharge of cooling air, and with flaps for temperature-controlled exhaust air routing either into the room or to the outside. Both variants can only be connected to an exhaust air duct when used in conjunction with the Super Silent enclosure. Compressor block Our compressor blocks are based on decades of experience and development. An efficient air cooling system with large coolers and finned cylinders ensures optimal cooling. Robust industrial roller bearings, pressure lubrication, and fine oil filters minimize wear. Dynamically balanced drive units ensure smooth operation and long maintenance intervals. P 41 DUO Purification system With two filter housings, an additional oil and water separator, and a pressure-retaining non-return valve, the P 41 DUO Purification system ensures reliable breathing air purification. A sealed, type-tested final pressure safety valve guarantees high operational safety. The processable air volume is 2,200 Nm³. B-CONTROL MICRO compressor control system The B-CONTROL MICRO is a modern, user-friendly compressor control system with a color display that intelligently manages and reliably monitors all basic functions. Interaction between the user and the control system is intuitive and straightforward, with information displayed in clear text. Various languages are available. External signal transmitters can be connected at any time, and operation in a networked system or with an external display is also possible.
